title: Suppliers
offline: Refresh failed — cached details may be out of date.
privacy: Refreshes on open; cached for 15 minutes. No background polling.

setupHelp: Requires the ServiceM8 Suppliers add-on, installed and enabled in your account: Account → Features & Integrations → Suppliers. Your API key is shared automatically with My Jobs Today. Enter it once in either plugin, with read access for suppliers, staff, schedules, jobs, customers and Job Contacts. Creating, editing or deleting suppliers also requires supplier write access (manage_suppliers).
createHelp: Name is required. Other fields are optional. Saving creates the supplier in ServiceM8 using your shared connection.
createSavedRefreshFailed: Supplier saved to ServiceM8. The list could not refresh; the new supplier is shown below. Refresh to try again.
invalidForm: Check the supplier details and field lengths.
duplicateFound: A supplier with this name or email already exists. Check the list before creating another.
allowDuplicate: I have checked and want to create another supplier.
createPermission: Supplier write access is required. Update your shared API key to allow managing suppliers.

deleteHelp: This deletes the supplier from ServiceM8 and removes it from the active supplier list. ServiceM8 keeps it as an archived record.
deletePrompt: Type yes below, then click Delete from ServiceM8.
deleteSavedRefreshFailed: Supplier deleted from ServiceM8. The list could not refresh; the deleted supplier has been removed locally.
deleteConfirmRequired: Type exactly yes to confirm deletion.
deleteInvalid: The supplier could not be identified. Cancel and select it again.
deletePermission: Supplier write access is required. Update your shared API key to allow managing suppliers.
deleteChanged: This supplier’s name changed in ServiceM8. Cancel, refresh, and select it again.
deleteRejected: ServiceM8 rejected the deletion. Refresh and try again.
deleteUncertain: Could not confirm deletion. Refresh before retrying. Type yes again to confirm another attempt.
